  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.

  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.

Your mission will be to transform fragile scripts into well-documented, testable, and resilient workflows, while leading the migration of legacy schedulers and Airflow instances into a managed Airflow environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys reverse-engineering complex systems, creating clarity out of chaos, and driving high-impact modernization efforts.

What You'll Do

  • Map legacy systems: read Python/SQL (occasional PHP), document data flows, dependencies, and failure modes.
  • Modernize & de-risk: refactor scripts, add tests, improve retries/idempotency, kill redundant jobs.
  • Migrate to managed Airflow (AWS): plan DAG moves, secrets, CI/CD, and observability.
  • Improve reliability/visibility: alerting, on-call-friendly logs, backfill strategies, fewer false alarms.
  • Partner with stakeholders: capture the "why," translate to requirements, communicate trade-offs/timelines.
  • Raise the bar: code reviews, mentoring, security/documentation culture.

Requirements

  • 5+ years software engineering. Strong Python (3.x). Advanced SQL (schema design, tuning) on a major RDBMS.
  • Experience owning production schedulers/pipelines (cron/Airflow/etc.).
  • Comfortable reading unfamiliar code and producing clear docs/designs.
  • Git, CI/CD, Linux, AWS; solid testing/debugging and pragmatic refactoring.
  • Excellent communication with non-engineering partners.

Nice to Have

  • PHP familiarity for legacy jobs/apps; Django.
  • Airflow (DAG design, sensors/operators, backfills) and migrations to managed Airflow.
  • ETL/ELT patterns; queues (SQS/Pub/Sub/Kafka); observability (Datadog/CloudWatch/Otel); IaC (Terraform); containers (Docker); secrets mgmt (Vault/SSM/Secret Manager).

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A cultura organizacional é guiada por valores como ética, responsabilidade social, inovação e excelência em gestão . A Fundação valoriza o trabalho colaborativo, estimulando a troca de conhecimento entre diferentes áreas, a capacitação contínua e o fortalecimento das equipes.

Na Controladoria, o ambiente é dinâmico e desafiador, reunindo profissionais comprometidos com a conformidade contábil e legal e com a missão institucional da FJS. A área de Prestação de Contas atua como elo estratégico entre contabilidade, faturamento, jurídico e setores técnicos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a integridade das informações.

Sobre a Vaga

Garantir conformidade na aplicação e prestação de contas dos recursos públicos, atendendo às exigências legais, contratuais e dos órgãos fiscalizadores.

Supervisionar e orientar a equipe , assegurando qualidade, prazos e integridade das informações.

Coordenar processos contábeis e financeiros , incluindo encerramento do exercício e publicação das demonstrações.

Atuar de forma estratégica , elaborando relatórios gerenciais, indicadores e apoiando a tomada de decisão.

Representar a área em auditorias , prestando esclarecimentos técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a equipe responsável pela elaboração e análise das prestações de contas financeiras e técnicas, assegurando conformidade com os contratos de gestão, convênios, termos de colaboração e demais instrumentos firmados com entes públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.
  • Coordenar a organização, validação e arquivamento da documentação comprobatória da aplicação dos recursos públicos (notas fiscais, recibos, folhas de pagamento, extratos bancários, relatórios de execução e comprovantes de recolhimento de encargos sociais, etc.).
  • Acompanhar a escrituração e análise dos registros contábeis relacionados às prestações de contas, assegurando a consistência das informações lançadas e a correta vinculação às rubricas contratuais.
  • Coordenar os processos de encerramento do exercício contábil e garantir a adequada elaboração e publicação das demonstrações contábeis dos contratos, em conformidade com as normas vigentes e exigências contratuais e legais.
  • Controlar os prazos de entrega das prestações de contas e relatórios contábeis, garantindo atendimento às cláusulas contratuais e legislações aplicáveis.
  • Atuar como elo entre a área de prestação de contas e os setores de contabilidade, faturamento, suprimentos, jurídico e assistência, assegurando a rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica à equipe e às unidades executoras quanto à correta aplicação dos recursos públicos e ao atendimento das demandas dos órgãos fiscalizadores.
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho, oferecendo suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica e à melhoria contínua dos processos de controle institucional.
  • Representar a área perante auditorias internas e externas, prestando esclarecimentos técnicos sempre que necessário.
  • Manter-se atualizado e disseminar à equipe a legislação e normas aplicáveis ao Terceiro Setor e à gestão de recursos públicos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica: Bacharelado em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência: Vivência prévia em supervisão ou coordenação de equipes; experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em rotinas contábeis e prestação de contas, preferencialmente no Terceiro Setor ou em instituições que atuem em parcerias com o poder público.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Legislação e normas contábeis; Legislação e normas de gestão de recursos públicos e Terceiro Setor; Domínio do Pacote Office (nível intermediário/avançado em Excel); Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão contábil e financeira (ERP); Desejável domínio de plataformas de prestação de contas e relatórios físico-financeiros.

Habilidades e Competências

  • Liderança e capacidade de coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e foco em prazos.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação de documentos contábeis, financeiros e legais.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para interface institucional.
  • Proatividade, visão sistêmica e habilidade de negociação.

We are creating a new D2C subscription product and are looking for a Managing Director to oversee day-to-day operations, drive execution, and build a world-class team.

Profit Share

This role comes with a profit-sharing incentive and stock options with high earning potential. More details will be shared during the interview.

You will be building a strong team with high talent density who enjoy working in our fast-paced, 100% remote environment.

You are a dynamic and hands-on leader with extensive experience in the D2C Digital Products space (preferably subscriptions). You excel at driving growth and innovation, with a deep understanding of engineering, product, marketing, and growth strategies. You will lead all departments with a focus on executing strategic initiatives and optimizing performance across the board. Your proven ability to manage teams, deliver results under pressure, and engage in the technical and operational aspects of the business makes you a strong candidate to steer our company toward continued success.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the company's strategic growth by developing and executing initiatives that drive business expansion, optimize market positioning, and advance overall progress.

  • Oversee marketing campaigns, ensuring they are data-driven, customer-centric, and aligned with product launches and sales strategies.
  • Utilize data analytics to refine and optimize growth strategies, ensuring sustainable revenue growth.
  • Monitor and analyze key financial and operational metrics such as revenue growth, EBITDA margins, and customer acquisition costs (CAC).
  • Evaluate customer lifetime value (LTV) and return on ad spend (ROAS) to optimize marketing efficiency and resource allocation.
  • Track onboarding conversion rates to identify areas for improvement in user experience and increase customer activation; analyze ARPU and retention rates to inform product development and profitability.

What we offer

Ruby Labs operates in the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome as long as they are within approximately ±4 hours of CET to ensure optimal collaboration during working hours.

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we review it, typically within 3 to 5 days. If there is potential fit, the steps usually include:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

We move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. This is a place for ambitious, driven individuals who want to grow and make an impact. We recognize those who deliver results and provide opportunities for more responsibility and growth.

  • Highly self-motivated and directed.

  • Direct hands-on experience with Java and Apache Groovy, test automation frameworks, Selenium/Appium/Playwright, RestAssured.

description:
Sobre Nós

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa que é referência em TI, impulsionando a inovação e transformando o mercado desde 2001?

Venha para a Qualificar TI!

Na Qualificar TI, somos especialistas em Governança de Dados, Gerenciamento de Projetos, Transformação Digital e Outsourcing. Oferecemos soluções estratégicas e as melhores práticas para atender às necessidades técnicas de nossos clientes.

O Que Buscamos

Procuramos gente apaixonada por tecnologia, que quer crescer e se desenvolver num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Queremos pessoas que:

  • Tenham perfil de Transformação Digital e sejam inovadoras.
  • Busquem continuamente por conhecimento e aprimoramento.
  • Sejam proativas e comprometidas com a entrega de resultados.
  • Valorizem o compartilhamento de experiências e o trabalho em equipe.

Por Que Trabalhar na Qualificar TI?

  • Ambiente Inovador: Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time dedicado e dinâmico, que valoriza o seu conhecimento e incentiva o seu crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Oferecemos um espaço onde a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento são contínuos, proporcionando a você as ferramentas e o suporte necessários para crescer profissionalmente.
  • Impacto Real: Contribua para projetos que realmente fazem a diferença para nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas e soluções tecnológicas.

Se identificou? Então, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a oportunidade

Responsável por coordenar a operação da infraestrutura de TIC, envolvendo servidores, redes, bancos de dados e segurança. A atuação exige visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança técnica e foco em alta disponibilidade e continuidade dos serviços.

Atividades principais

  • Supervisionar as equipes técnicas de infraestrutura (N3 e NOC);
  • Planejar e monitorar a operação contínua dos serviços de TIC;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs, segurança da informação e estabilidade da operação;
  • Apoiar técnicos à equipe na solução de incidentes críticos;
  • Elaborar relatórios de operação e apoiar processos de auditoria.

Requisitos obrigatórios

O profissional deverá possuir curso superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) , ou curso superior completo em qualquer área , desde que complementado com pós-graduação na área de TI , realizada em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

São exigidas as seguintes certificações e formações complementares:

  • Certificação ISO/IEC 27001 ;
  • Certificação ITIL 4 , sendo exigido, no mínimo, o módulo Specialist – Create, Deliver & Support , ou certificação equivalente ou superior da mesma trilha;
  • Certificação HDI – SCTL (Support Center Team Lead) ;
  • Curso de capacitação em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux .

Além da formação e certificações, o profissional deve comprovar:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em atividades técnicas relacionadas à área de TI;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 (três) anos em gestão de projetos e liderança de equipes técnicas .

Adicionalmente, é obrigatória a apresentação de ao menos uma das seguintes certificações reconhecidas na área de gerenciamento de projetos e/ou serviços de TI :

  • PMP – Project Management Professional ;
  • CAPM – Certified Associate in Project Management

Overview

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, com 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico. Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos à procura de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) altamente habilidoso(a) e apaixonado(a) por tecnologia para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Como desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack , você desempenhará um papel fundamental na criação e manutenção de sistemas robustos, escaláveis e eficientes que apoiem nossos processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e integração de dados. Você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, incluindo Java e React.js, NoSQL (MongoDB), arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir que nosso sistema seja altamente observável e fácil de depurar.

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs back end e front end que suportem os processos de ETL e integração de dados (Java e React.js);
  • Implementar soluções de armazenamento de dados NoSQL, como MongoDB, para armazenar e consultar dados de forma eficaz;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de integração baseados em eventos para facilitar a comunicação entre os diferentes componentes do sistema;
  • Trabalhar com protocolos FTP e lidar com arquivos posicionais para a troca de dados com parceiros externos;
  • Garantir que o sistema de ETL seja altamente observável, permitindo a fácil depuração de problemas e a monitoração de desempenho;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos e garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam às necessidades de negócios;
  • Realizar testes de unidade, integração e aceitação para garantir a qualidade do código;
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada e participar na revisão de código;
  • Ficar atualizado com as melhores práticas e tendências em desenvolvimento back end e front end.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end e front end, em um ambiente de microserviços com Linguagem Java, Spring Boot, React.js;
  • Conhecimento sólido em NoSQL, com experiência prática em MongoDB;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas ETL;
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, AZURE);
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos FTP e manipulação de arquivos posicionais;
  • Habilidade de escrever código limpo, escalável e de fácil manutenção;
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada;
  • Inglês avançado (atuará em time internacional).

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. Overview

Join to apply for the Wine Supervisor Club Med Resort Brazil ou no estrangeiro role at Club Med

Do you know Club Med? We have nearly 70 resorts, open in summer and winter, in 26 countries. We offer high-end vacations in the mountains and by the sea. Our customers are looking for happiness and freedom.

Why are you reading this job offer? Because you want to become an actor of this little extra that makes all our difference. You have human and professional skills that are in demand.

We offer you the opportunity to develop and evolve very quickly by joining our brilliant teams. You will be able to travel around the world.

Your working environment

Each Resort has several restaurants and bars, both event-based and more intimate, serving our Premium All Inclusive offer. From buffets to plated service, from show cooking experiences to numerous festive events, you will have no shortage of opportunities to express your know-how and creativity while enriching yourself with all our facets. Our refined offer is based on 5 pillars: creating memorable experiences, surprising with a multitude of conceptual catering spaces, working for the well-being of everyone (including your own), playing on the emotions and senses through the staging, all in a fun and relaxed atmosphere.

You are

  • Sociable, you know how to connect with our guests and build a trusting relationship.
  • Efficient, you know how to manage priorities and ensure timely service.
  • Attentive, you ensure each guest receives personalised service.

You will

  • Ensure the sale and service of wines and spirits in the Concept area (wine cellar and delicatessen), bars and various restaurants of the resort
  • Coach, train and motivate its team of salespeople specialized in wines and spirits
  • Listen to and advise customers carefully, according to their tastes and respecting the food and wine pairing.
  • Ensure the personalization of the customer journey and the respect of the proposed offer
  • Ensure the stock management and the good conservation of the products in the cellar and the grocery store
  • Develop additional sales and get involved in optimizing the economic results of its service
  • Organize and promote events around the products of the cellar and grocery store in the resort
  • Guarantee the application and respect of the hygiene and safety standards, as well as respect for heritage.

Joining our teams is also a unique opportunity to live and work with people from all walks of life, in the most Instagrammable locations in the world.

You'll create a golden experience on your resume, within a company that accompanies you and trains you continuously to help you become the best version of yourself.

By becoming a G.O Wine Cellar Supervisor, you will be able to benefit from the infrastructures and activities offered by Club Med. If you feel like it, you can even go on stage to show your talents!

So, ready to join us? Your future starts here… All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Student Success Manager (Remoto)
description:
Overview

A TripleTen é uma escola de tecnologia norte-americana, reconhecida internacionalmente e premiada por sua excelência no ensino. Estamos crescendo rapidamente na América Latina, ajudando milhares de pessoas a ingressarem na indústria tech, independentemente do nível de experiência inicial .

Nossos profissionais são de diversos países, criando um ambiente multicultural, dinâmico e colaborativo . No Brasil, trabalhamos de forma 100% remota , proporcionando mais flexibilidade e qualidade de vida, sem abrir mão do crescimento profissional.

Aqui, valorizamos talentos e incentivamos o desenvolvimento contínuo . Nossos colaboradores têm acesso a oportunidades de aprendizado, crescimento na carreira e desafios que impulsionam a sua evolução no mercado global.

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa, organizada e apaixonada por educação para atuar como Success Manager , acompanhando nossos alunos durante toda a jornada de aprendizagem. Se você gosta de se conectar com pessoas, criar comunidade, resolver problemas e garantir que ninguém fique para trás, essa vaga é para você!

What you will do

  • Dar boas-vindas aos novos alunos e conduzir sessões de onboarding (online);
  • Manter a comunidade ativa, promovendo eventos, conteúdos e interações entre alunos;
  • Fazer check-ins individuais para acompanhar o bem-estar e o progresso dos alunos;
  • Oferecer suporte em dúvidas e dificuldades, garantindo uma experiência positiva de ponta a ponta;
  • Acompanhar até 150 alunos, organizando cronogramas, registros, lembretes e relatórios;
  • Colaborar com tutores e instrutores, participando de reuniões e coordenando ações em equipe;
  • Engajar alunos inativos, com uma abordagem personalizada e próxima.

Requirements

  • Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência em atendimento ao cliente ou funções similares (Customer Success, Suporte, Gestão de Alunos, etc.);
  • Excelente organização, comunicação e empatia;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos alunos de forma eficiente e atenciosa;
  • Facilidade para falar em público e se apresentar em videochamadas;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade para resolver problemas de forma autônoma;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (como Google Workspace);
  • Inglês intermediário é um diferencial;
  • Interesse ou experiência no setor de tecnologia, educação ou edtech é um bônus!

What we can offer you

  • Remuneração Fixa: 700 USD por mês
  • Trabalho Remoto: Colaboração totalmente remota e com liberdade profissional.
  • Equipe Dinâmica: Faça parte de um time global e diverso, com experiência em tecnologia, edtech e diversos setores.
  • Trabalho com Propósito: Seus esforços impactam diretamente as taxas de sucesso dos alunos em conseguir emprego após a formatura.
  • Igualdade de Oportunidades: A TripleTen valoriza a diversidade e considera todos os candidatos qualificados, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência, estado civil, orientação sexual, identidade/expressão de gênero, ou qualquer outro fator legalmente protegido.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. Darkroom has evolved from a boutique design agency to one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and has received recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising.

About The Role

Editor at Darkroom: your primary duty is to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Editors add value to client work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is passionate about using editing skills to tell compelling stories and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns
  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across multiple brands
  • Strong Motion Graphics/Graphic Design/Typography skills
  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + Final Cut Pro X (FCPX)
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)
  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)
  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment
  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices
  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proficient with animation/graphic design

What You'll Do

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats
  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging
  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats
  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices
  • Be a creative collaborator: have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content authentic for all channels
  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction in a fast-paced environment
  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios
  • Set up projects for edit staff
  • Ingesting and logging footage
  • Work in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines
  • Editing lower-level projects
  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)
  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects
  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs
  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits
  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server OS, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)
  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment
  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers; produce high-quality video edits spanning various media platforms as requested
  • Performance creative editing in collaboration with the performance marketing team reviewing ad analytics/performance

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics .

Location: Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona. Parental leave benefits support new parents. Our agency emphasizes cross-functional collaboration and opportunities for growth through total immersion in diverse services.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um time de mais de 12 mil pessoas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Formamos um ecossistema que se estende por todo o país e que ultrapassa fronteiras, integrando e conectando negócios. Sabemos que o crescimento acontece de gente para gente, e é isso que nos move.

Nosso jeito de ser:

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

Bem-Estar Integral : Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

Pluralidade : A diversidade faz parte de quem a gente é. Reconhecidos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil, promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa. Nossa expertise é humana e viva, e através dela, acolhemos e empoderamos pessoas dentro e fora da empresa.

Seu desafio no time

Você fará parte da área de Ciência de Dados da RD Station, contribuindo para iniciativas estratégicas que integram análise avançada, modelagem preditiva e inovação tecnológica. Atuará no ciclo completo de projetos de dados — desde a exploração e preprocessamento até a entrega de modelos escaláveis —, com oportunidade de aplicar conhecimentos em IA generativa para resolver problemas complexos em produtos SaaS.

Suas principais entregas

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos preditivos, sistemas de recomendação e análises estatísticas para otimizar produtos e processos;
  • Aplicar técnicas de IA generativa em casos específicos, como personalização de conteúdo ou automação de tarefas, integrando-as a soluções tradicionais de machine learning;
  • Garantir reprodutibilidade e qualidade nas entregas, utilizando boas práticas de versionamento, testes e documentação;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e produto para estruturar pipelines robustos e alinhar modelos às necessidades do negócio;
  • Traduzir requisitos técnicos em insights acionáveis, mantendo equilíbrio entre inovação e viabilidade operacional.
  • Domínio em análise exploratória, modelagem estatística e construção de modelos de machine learning tradicionais (supervisionado e não supervisionado);
  • Experiência prática com IA generativa, incluindo LLMs e aplicações em cenários reais (ex: fine-tuning, RAG, avaliação de outputs);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python e bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy e Scikit-learn, além de familiaridade com frameworks de IA generativa (ex: LangChain, LlamaIndex);
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (SQL, manipulação de dados estruturados e não estruturados) e deployment de modelos em produção;
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas, com foco em escalabilidade e métricas claras de sucesso.

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Experiência em MLOps (MLflow, Airflow) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure);
  • Vivência em produtos SaaS B2B com alto volume de dados ou complexidade técnica;
  • Habilidade para comunicar resultados técnicos a stakeholders não técnicos;
  • Participação em projetos ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até o monitoramento pós-deploy;
  • Perfil que valorize a ciência por trás dos dados e saiba equilibrar inovação com pragmatismo.

Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade , descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

  • Capacidade de conduzir negociações de maneira transparente, firme e idônea;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e efetiva;
  • Familiaridade e gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Boa energia para viajar e sem restrições em ser alocado para cuidar de clientes em qualquer lugar do Brasil;

  • Comunicação direta: você é uma pessoa comunicadora ativa e ouvinte atenta. Você sabe receber bem feedbacks sinceros e vê cada um deles como uma oportunidade de crescer;

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Overview

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa que é referência em TI, impulsionando a inovação e transformando o mercado desde 2001?

Venha para a Qualificar TI!

Sobre Nós:

Na Qualificar TI, somos especialistas em Governança de Dados, Gerenciamento de Projetos, Transformação Digital e Outsourcing. Oferecemos soluções estratégicas e as melhores práticas para atender às necessidades técnicas de nossos clientes.

O Que Buscamos:

Procuramos gente apaixonada por tecnologia, que quer crescer e se desenvolver num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Queremos pessoas que:

  • Tenham perfil de Transformação Digital e sejam inovadoras.
  • Busquem continuamente por conhecimento e aprimoramento.
  • Sejam proativas e comprometidas com a entrega de resultados.
  • Valorizem o compartilhamento de experiências e o trabalho em equipe.

Por Que Trabalhar na Qualificar TI?

  • Ambiente Inovador: Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time dedicado e dinâmico, que valoriza o seu conhecimento e incentiva o seu crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Oferecemos um espaço onde a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento são contínuos, proporcionando a você as ferramentas e o suporte necessários para crescer profissionalmente.
  • Impacto Real: Contribua para projetos que realmente fazem a diferença para nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas e soluções tecnológicas.

Se identificou? Então, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

No dia-a-dia quais são os desafios que iremos enfrentar?

Atuação estratégica no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial, com foco na criação de agentes autônomos que otimizem processos organizacionais e contribuam para a construção futura de uma Large Language Model (LLM) proprietária. O profissional integrará o ecossistema de dados do Sebrae, operando de forma remota e sob demanda, dentro do nosso Programa de Inteligência de Dados.

Atividades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de ciência de dados voltados para o desenvolvimento de agentes de IA e sistemas autônomos conectados à plataforma AgentSpace ou similares.
  • Planejar e implementar experimentos envolvendo Machine Learning, Deep Learning e NLP, com vistas à futura construção de uma LLM.
  • Desenvolver soluções preditivas e prescritivas baseadas em grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Participar da concepção, avaliação e iteração de modelos de agentes inteligentes alinhados aos princípios de produtividade, confiabilidade e privacidade.
  • Atuar junto a squads ágeis, colaborando com engenheiros de dados, arquitetos de soluções e analistas de negócios para entrega contínua de valor.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência comprovada em ciência de dados, com atuação em projetos complexos e de alta criticidade.
  • Domínio de algoritmos de aprendizado de máquina, redes neurais e processamento de linguagem natural (NLP).
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python, R e/ou Java, com experiência prática no uso de bibliotecas e frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers, LangChain etc.
  • Experiência com captura, organização e modelagem de dados em ambientes de Big Data.
  • Sensibilidade de negócio, com capacidade de traduzir objetivos estratégicos em soluções orientadas por dados.

description:
The Solution Expert’s mission is to manage the consistency between the business practices & processes for his/her domain and the underlying IT solutions. The Solution Expert assesses any new business needs requiring IT solution development and evolution, manages the realization of the functional requirements and validates the requested development, before user acceptance. This person is an expert within the Supply Chain business areas (Planning, Inventory, Manufacturing and Distribution) and works closely with the business owners to assist in business technology strategic development, solution discovery, and service management. This person serves as the functional point of contact for the Supply Chain business area and is the link to the various IT resources needed for successful implementation of business needs.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with each business line in the definition of business requirements and ensure scope of work and business cases are clearly defined within their projects.
  • Assists the business users and the technical support team in application support for critical issues.
  • Acts as the liaison between business users, PMO, and IT technical teams.
  • Ensure that IT resources (people, costs, systems, hardware) are aligned with business needs.
  • Create shared vision of their respective solutions and facilitate decision making and arbitration relating to trade-offs both within and between different solution platforms
  • Drive IT innovation, best practices, and cost efficiencies to improve the financial and operational performance of the business operations
  • Documents the functional designs for all enhancements and projects.
  • Works with the technical teams in the execution and design of application enhancements and digital projects.
  • Prioritize and delegate tasks and responsibilities to appropriate IT personnel as needed
  • Assists in the execution of the Digital and IT roadmap.
  • Process improvement: Works with his/her team as well as with cross-functional teams to continuously improve work processes. Continuously analyze the functioning of the activity, identifies causes of dysfunctions and proposes corrective measures accordingly.
  • Maintains an excellent relationship with key business stakeholders.
  • Assist the users (customers) in acceptance testing, developing procedures, and updating documentation.
  • Empower all users by creating a community of practice.

Requirements

Education, Training or Certification Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or a related discipline
  • 8+ years experience in two of the three areas: Business/Operations, IT, or Project Management.
  • Strong knowledge of Supply Chain, Asset Management and Manufacturing processes and applications.
  • Experience with Oracle and SAP ERP systems

General Requirements and Knowledge:

  • Ability to speak English (a must), Spanish and possibly Portuguese would be preferable.
  • Customer-oriented and service-driven: Precisely answers customer requests, is attentive to customers, respects commitments towards customers and initiates new ideas in order to meet customer expectations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills: Gets to know others and forms relationships, maintains very good relationships with colleagues, respects the ideas and opinions of others.
  • Team Player: Shares knowledge and experience, cooperates and makes self available, listens, gathers information, takes into consideration the needs, ideas, opinions of others.
  • Problem-Solving: Identifies problem situations within an appropriate time frame, develops several alternative solutions to problems, analyzes situations and highlights important issues, suggests adequate, valuable and feasible solutions.
  • Decision-making skills: Considers all factors before making a decision, makes quick decisions when necessary and accepts the consequences and risks involved.
  • Technical Abilities: Masters concepts, tools and methods related to his/her job, meets or exceeds professional requirements of his/her field of work, keeps abreast of progress in his/her field.
  • Initiative: initiates actions, ideas or solutions spontaneously on his own, undertakes action without waiting for directives, uses all of his/her resources before asking for help, establishes his/her performance objectives and deadlines.
  • Ability to achieve consensus between stakeholders with divergent interests
  • Ability to understand and translate business requirements into technical requirements and vice versa
  • Demonstrated experience in managing projects

Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Join to apply for the Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional) role at tl;dv - AI Meeting Assistant

Hi

Great that you are here!

This job posting is all about the specific role that you could take at tl;dv. Because company culture is extremely important for us, please also have a look at our tl;dv Culture & Careers page. We love to be different. To get an idea of the brand that we are building, check out our Product Hunt launch. Jack Nicholson will share with you how he thinks about meetings. If you then like what you read - shoot over your application! We\'re looking for highly motivated team players to join our hungry squad.

What You'll Do

  • Join to apply for the Brand Design at tl;dv
  • Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome)
  • Compensation set based on agreed hours / work scope of part-time role (flexible)
  • Engagement

Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact

  • Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design

About The Opportunity

We\'re building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You\'ll Do

You\'ll partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to:

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts from insight to production to iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns - and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you\'ve got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal .

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and support our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: You will execute a customer-centric approach across all client interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (e.g., Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required

What You'll Do

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats
  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging
  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats
  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Editing lower-level projects

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Hi – this job posting outlines the role you could take at tl;dv. We are a remote-first, fast-paced team building a differentiated brand in AI/SaaS.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and selective boldness.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; have references ready.
  • Not afraid to be bold; defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego collaborator with clear communication.
  • Tools: Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stopping, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

About Us

CALSTART is a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, CALSTART’s mission is to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

About the Role

The purpose of the Project Manager 2, Trucks role is to ensure the effective implementation and management of Incentive Projects and other CALSTART initiatives. This involves educating and training stakeholders, improving technical systems, streamlining administrative processes, and ensuring data management and reporting. By coordinating with internal teams and engaging external stakeholders, the role will support project successes and foster strong relationships within the industry and with regulatory bodies.

The Project Manager 2, Trucks role will support external stakeholders by educating and training dealers and equipment purchasers, addressing their inquiries, and assisting with Salesforce technical issues to ensure smooth participation in the incentive projects. For internal stakeholders, the role will streamline project administration, update incentive websites and equipment catalogs, and handle data acquisition and reporting. They will lead the development of standard operating procedures, help organize events and webinars, draft communications, and ensure coordinated efforts and effective project execution. This role also involves collaborating with internal teams and engaging with industry participants and funders to maintain stakeholder relationships and support the overall success of CALSTART initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead dealer education initiative and involvement, training dealers and purchasers on participating in the incentive projects (e.g. responding to inquiry emails, assisting with or escalating Salesforce technical issues, preparing presentations to inform how the voucher processes work, etc.)
  • Assist with all tasks related to administering incentive projects by fulfilling functions as outlined in grant agreements, including but not limited to developing Implementation Manuals, policies, and procedures, streamlining voucher approval and processing workflows in Salesforce, and engaging industry stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with participating OEMs and dealers to drive outreach initiatives, manage and oversee equipment eligibility verification and catalog management while developing and implementing standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline processes and ensure accuracy and consistency across projects
  • Input new OEMs, Dealers, and Equipment to the Voucher Processing Center catalog, provide feedback to the Salesforce development team on system processes for improvements or maintenance, and lead efforts to improve the dealer user experience of Voucher Processing Center, and assist the Voucher Processing team with system issues or processing inquiries.
  • Help with monthly data acquisition, validation, and reporting (e.g. manage vendor data collection process, work with internal data and validation team to create monthly reports) and keep records for engagements and meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Use CALSTART CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems such as Salesforce and Monday.com to keep and maintain records and perform and track daily tasks.
  • Lead the development of standard operating procedures for internal processes and using project management tools to further develop enhancements of the program as it pertains to reporting, program funding launches, and program development.
  • Support organizing and attending project-related workshops, events, forums, presentations, and webinars, such as drafting announcement emails and presentation slides, coordinating with communications managing webinars, and strategize communication tactics for workgroups and webinars
  • Assist with other tasks or other CALSTART initiatives as requested by other teams/departments

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, with strong skills in timeline development, resource allocation, budget management, risk assessment, and cross-functional team coordination.
  • 1-2 years of experience with Salesforce, including skills in custom object creation, workflow automation, report generation, data management, and user administration.
  • Project management experience demonstrating proficiency in scope definition, team leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience with Salesforce, including skills in data integration, process automation, dashboard creation, and system customization.
  • Experience supporting diverse stakeholders, with skills in effective communication, conflict resolution, needs assessment, and tailored solution delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and streamline administrative workflows, with skills in process optimization, documentation management, and workflow automation.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders, utilizing collaboration tools, stakeholder management techniques, cross-functional coordination, and conflict resolution strategies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Public Policy, Business Administration, or related fields, with skills in data analysis, project management, policy development, and stakeholder communication.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in sales, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual support.
  • Experience in the Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) industry or related initiatives, showcasing a strong understanding of industry-specific trends and regulations.

Salary: $72,000 - $85,760 a year

CALSTART values transparency and strives to provide as much information regarding compensation as possible. The complete salary range for this role is $72,000-$85,760. Pay is determined based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, experience, education, internal equity and other factors relevant to the job.

We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn’t perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

We care about your personal well being as much as your professional success and offer generous benefits to full time employees including: 100% company paid comprehensive health benefits for Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, Retirement plan with generous company contributions, FSA for Health and Dependent Care, 3 weeks of vacation time in the first year of employment, 11 paid company holidays, paid sick time, paid family leave, and more!

Our inclusive environment focuses on making decisions based on merit without regard to race, color, hair texture, gender, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, LGBTQIA+ status, marital status, pregnancy, disability, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Resumo da Função – Vendedor Interno | Gran Oil

Vendedor Interno da Gran Oil é o profissional responsável por executar atividades comerciais relacionadas à venda técnica de óleo para queima , atendendo principalmente usinas de asfalto, caldeiras industriais e outros grandes consumidores.

Sua função vai muito além de vender: ele é responsável por conduzir negociações estratégicas , apresentar propostas com clareza, acompanhar o processo comercial do início ao fim , e manter relacionamento próximo com o cliente — seja por ligação, proposta formal, ou suporte em visitas e viagens.

Entre suas principais atribuições estão:

  • Vendas diretas e consultivas com foco em volume (m³)
  • Negociação de preço, prazo, condições de pagamento e pacotes personalizados
  • Envio de propostas comerciais alinhadas às diretrizes da empresa
  • Suporte à equipe de campo e acompanhamento de visitas técnicas
  • Organização da carteira de clientes e priorização da agenda de atendimento
  • Registro e atualização constante das oportunidades no sistema de CRM (Pipedrive)

O Vendedor Interno atua como um elo entre a estratégia comercial e o resultado real em campo, sendo peça-chave na expansão e no fortalecimento da marca Gran Oil no mercado nacional .

Descrição da Função – Vendedor Interno Gran Oil

O Vendedor Interno da Gran Oil é responsável por representar tecnicamente e comercialmente nossos produtos e serviços , atuando de forma estratégica para expandir nossa carteira de clientes no setor industrial, usinas de asfalto e outros segmentos de consumo de óleo para queima.

Entre suas responsabilidades, estão:

  • Demonstrar e apresentar os diferenciais dos produtos Gran Oil, incluindo OMF e óleo intermediário
  • Analisar o perfil dos clientes e o mercado da região, buscando entender a demanda e comportamento de compra
  • Entender profundamente os produtos e sua aplicação em caldeiras, fornos e usinas
  • Organizar uma agenda de visitas e contatos com os principais clientes e prospects
  • Realizar ligações e agendamentos de visitas externas, em conjunto com o time de campo
  • Elaborar e enviar propostas comerciais, alinhadas com as diretrizes da empresa
  • Negociar prazos, volumes e condições de pagamento, propondo também pacotes promocionais ou estratégias personalizadas para o cliente
  • Acompanhar o time em viagens e visitas técnicas, quando necessário, para reforçar o relacionamento e apoiar no fechamento
  • Registrar todas as interações e oportunidades no CRM (Pipedrive), mantendo organização e rastreabilidade das negociações
  • Trabalhar com foco em bater metas de volume (m³), propostas enviadas e conversões reais

O papel exige comprometimento com resultado, senso de responsabilidade, iniciativa comercial e capacidade de comunicação técnica e consultiva .

title: Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)
description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome). Compensation is set based on agreed hours/work scope for a part-time role (flexible).

Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About The Opportunity

We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight ? moodboard ? concept ? production ? iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you’ve got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points If You...

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal — your role — outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. We move fast. The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond.

To learn more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page!

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Overview

Reports to: Marketing Manager

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love supporting the execution of effective marketing campaigns? Are you a detail-oriented organizer with a knack for optimizing processes and coordinating creative production?

If you have experience managing content calendars, coordinating creative projects, and optimizing marketing operations, keep reading. As our Marketing Coordinator, you will work closely with the Marketing Manager and the creative team to ensure all marketing content is produced efficiently, aligns with strategic goals, and is delivered on time. You will maintain a rolling 3-month content calendar, manage the production of creative assets, and ensure data on our marketing dashboard is accurate and actionable. This role supports marketing initiatives across digital, social media, email, and more.

Base pay range

$14,400.00/yr - $20,000.00/yr

Responsibilities

  • Content Calendar Management: Design and maintain a 3-month rolling content calendar that is always at least 80% filled with planned content; coordinate with creative, copywriting, and social media teams to ensure alignment and timely publication; implement tools and processes to track production and optimize calendar engagement.
  • Creative Production Coordination: Ensure the creation and completion of a minimum of 35 creative concepts per month (including 25 videos and 10 images); manage timelines, allocate resources, and prioritize content based on strategic objectives; provide regular progress updates.
  • Dashboard Implementation and Management: Design and implement a Looker dashboard to monitor production metrics; set up automated data pipelines for real-time accuracy; continuously optimize the dashboard to support data-driven decisions.
  • Process Optimization: Develop streamlined workflows for content creation, approval, and scheduling; use flowcharts to identify improvement areas and implement new tools as needed.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the Marketing Manager, creative, and other teams to align on strategies and priorities; facilitate regular meetings and clear communications on deadlines and updates.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Prepare weekly and monthly reports on content output, turnaround times, and approval rates; analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in marketing coordination, content management, or a similar role
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello) and content management systems
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) and experience in building dashboards
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Creative problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to improving processes

Benefits

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Remote Work Environment with optional in-person office in New Jersey
  • Professional Development: training, resources, and conferences
  • Career Growth Opportunities across operations, sales, creative, and media buying
  • Company Events and Team Building: quarterly in-person events and virtual meetups
  • Technology Stipend for home office equipment and tools
  • Impactful Work: contribute to growth for high-growth clients
